what: Recorded experiment on the MOT17-09 upload: confirm only the possible missed crossings that ground truth (checked offline, never shown in the UI) says are real, and see what an adjusted count would have been. Confirming the real suggestion moved IN 4->5, away from the true 3; adjusted counts are not shown in the UI.
pipeline: detection + tracking on the raw upload frames (in memory); the face-only oval blur is applied only to the served copy, stills and annotated render; the raw upload was deleted when the job ended (files left: blurred.mp4, first_frame.jpg, meta.json)
upload: MOT17-09 (960x540, 525 frames, 30 fps) via Studio step 4 /dashboard/studio/your-video; gate clicked at (0.02, 0.65) -> (0.98, 0.65) of the first frame (stored as y=0.6481); ours/visibility_botsort on CPU, YOLOX-S
truth_method: MOT17-09 gt.txt (pedestrians, visible) on the job's gate scaled to 1920x1080, hysteresis scaled the same way; plain crossings matched one-to-one to true ones (same direction, within 15 frames); a suggestion is real if it matches one-to-one a true crossing the plain count missed (same direction, within 15 frames). Script: python -m eval.operator_demo

adjusted_count_experiment.note: Tracker count + the one confirmed real suggestion, computed when the UI still had an 'Operator-adjusted' card. Confirming the real suggestion moved IN 4->5, away from the true 3, because 6 of the 15 counted crossings are false and stay in. Adjusted counts are not shown in the UI: Studio step 4 now shows only the tracker count, and Confirm / Dismiss are review notes saved to the exports.

list_order_in_ui: crossing time (all rows, no cap); pairing score shown as grey text
pair_score: 1 - 0.5*min(1, gap_s/max_gap_s) - 0.5*min(1, distance_rel/max_dist_rel), max_gap_s 4.0, max_dist_rel 2.0 (limits tuned on simulator seeds 0-9)
note: A first attempt of this run (job 3e04c61b343c) succeeded on the server but the browser script timed out waiting for the result under CPU load (demo-clip re-blur running); its tracks are identical to this job's.

superseded.why: tracked on the head-square blurred copy (detection read blurred frames)
tracked on the face-oval blurred copy (detection read blurred frames)

ui_now: One 'Tracker count' card. 'Moments worth checking (N)' lists the possible missed crossings and the unsure crossings; Confirm / Dismiss / Undo save a review_status in the crossings CSV and the review notes JSON and change no number on screen.
